TX.summary: HB 3909 prohibits cell phones, tablets, or laptops within voting rooms, and HB 521 prohibits loitering near curbside voting spaces.

TX.title: Texas Proposition 16, Citizenship Voting Requirement Amendment
TX.summary: Constitutional amendment explicitly stating only U.S. citizens may vote in Texas elections was approved, codifying a restriction already in state and federal law.

UT.title: By-Mail Ballots Now Have Tighter Deadlines in Utah
UT.summary: Utah law now requires mail ballots to be in clerks' possession by 8 p.m. on election night regardless of postmark.

UT.title: Utah Lawmakers Move to Set Higher Bar for Ballot Initiatives
UT.summary: Utah legislature advanced measures to raise the approval threshold for citizen-initiated ballot measures.

UT.title: Utah Becomes the Sixth State with a New Congressional Map Ahead of 2026 Elections
UT.summary: Utah adopted a new congressional redistricting map ahead of the 2026 elections.

UT.title: Utah Republicans Push Election Bills to Increase Transparency and Improve Voter Verification
UT.summary: The 2026 Utah legislative session features SB194 proposing voter verification with state ID numbers and an opt-in voter roll process.

VT.title: Vermont Election Law Changes (H.474 / Act 70) Signed Into Law
VT.summary: Governor Scott signed Act 70, making changes including extending absentee ballot processing from 30 to 45 days before elections and eliminating the $500 campaign finance threshold.

VT.title: Vermont H.474 - Sore Loser Law and Campaign Finance Changes
VT.summary: Act 70 prohibits candidates who lose a major party primary from appearing on the general election ballot as an independent for the same office.

VT.title: Vermont Requires Town Clerk Voter Checklist Audits
VT.summary: Under Act 70, town clerks must audit voter checklists to ensure they accurately correspond to prescribed district boundaries.

VA.title: Virginia General Assembly Places Constitutional Amendments on 2026 Ballot
VA.summary: The General Assembly approved four constitutional amendments for the 2026 ballot, including one allowing people convicted of felonies to vote upon release from incarceration.

VA.title: Virginia Redistricting Amendment Would Shift Congressional Districts
VA.summary: A congressional redistricting amendment placed on the April 2026 special election ballot could shift four Republican-held districts toward Democrats.

VA.title: 2025 Changes to Virginia's Election Laws
VA.summary: Virginia reduced the voter registration closure period from 21 days to 10 days before general and primary elections.

VA.title: Virginia Proposed Amendment for April 2026 Special Election
VA.summary: Virginia will hold a special election in April 2026 for a congressional redistricting constitutional amendment.

WA.title: New Elections Laws Passed in Washington in 2025
WA.summary: Washington enacted several election laws in 2025 addressing election integrity, digital security, and election administration procedures.

WA.title: Washington Requires Cybersecurity Standards for Elections (SB 5014)
WA.summary: SB 5014 requires county auditors to adopt cybersecurity standards by June 2027, including .gov domains for election websites and mandatory breach reporting.

WA.title: Tighter Rules for Challenges to Voter Registrations Clear WA House
WA.summary: HB 1916 passed the state House requiring voter registration challenges to be signed in ink and creating penalties for knowingly providing false information.

WA.title: Automatic Voter Registration Address Updates
WA.summary: Effective June 1, 2025, voter registration is automatically updated when a voter reports an address change to any state agency.

WV.title: West Virginia Enacts Photo ID Requirement for Voting (HB 3016)
WV.summary: Governor Morrisey signed HB 3016 requiring voters to present photo identification, replacing the previous non-photo ID requirement.

WV.title: WV House Approves Legislation Requiring Cities to Hold Elections on Same Day as State
WV.summary: The House passed legislation to require municipalities to align their elections with state election dates.

WI.title: Wisconsin to See Election Regulation Changes in 2026
WI.summary: Multiple election changes take effect in 2026 including a new law allowing candidates to withdraw from ballots up to a week before primaries.

WI.title: Wisconsin Voters Approve Constitutional Amendment to Enshrine Voter ID Law
WI.summary: Wisconsin voters approved a constitutional amendment enshrining the existing voter ID requirement, making it harder to repeal.

WI.title: Wisconsin Bill Would Repeal Ballot Drawdown Law and Require Risk-Limiting Audits
WI.summary: Draft legislation would ban Wisconsin's practice of randomly removing ballots when counts don't match, replacing it with mandatory risk-limiting audits.

WY.title: Wyoming 2025 Election Integrity Laws
WY.summary: Wyoming enacted laws requiring proof of U.S. citizenship and 30-day residency to register, and enhancing voter list maintenance using the SAVE program.

WY.title: Wyoming Lawmakers Advance Election Reforms Despite Concerns from Clerks
WY.summary: A legislative committee advanced six election reform bills for 2026 including mandatory hand-count audits and requiring pen-and-paper ballots as default.

WY.title: Wyoming Party Affiliation Change Deadline Tightened
WY.summary: New legislation requires voters to appear in person to declare or change party affiliation by a set deadline before primary elections.

WY.title: Mail-in Voting Under Fire in Wyoming
WY.summary: Wyoming legislative proposals target mail-in voting procedures as part of broader election reform efforts emphasizing in-person voting.

DC.title: Ranked-Choice Voting Will Be Used in D.C.'s June 2026 Primary Election
DC.summary: D.C. will implement ranked-choice voting for the June 16, 2026 primary election following voter approval of Initiative 83 in 2024 with 73% support.

DC.title: Ranked-Choice Voting on Track in D.C. After Delay Effort Fails in Council
DC.summary: A D.C. Council effort to delay ranked-choice voting until 2027 failed, clearing the way for the new system in the June 2026 primary.

DC.title: DC Council Votes to Implement Semi-Open Primaries Under Initiative 83
DC.summary: The D.C. Council voted 8-4 to fund Initiative 83, which alongside ranked-choice voting also allows unaffiliated voters to participate in party primaries.

DC.title: New Voter Registration Agencies Designated in D.C.
DC.summary: D.C. expanded voter registration access by designating Parks and Recreation, Corrections, Public Library, and Public Schools as official voter registration agencies.
